title: PixelPals
tagline: Inspired by the likes of Pokemon Go, users explore their neighbourhoods, looking for "PixelPals" to battle and catch.  Collect PixelPals and trade them (cross-chain) on our decentralised second-hand marketplace.

prizes.title: Best integration of the Web3Modal Mobile SDKS

description:
PixelPals is a Decentralized geo-location based game that merges blockchain, generative art NFTs, and deFi. In this unique gaming experience, users can engage in thrilling battles with vibrant pixel characters within their geographical area.

Dynamic Pixel Artwork:
PixelPals leverages the creative power of NounsDAO to generate dynamic and unique pixel artwork. Each pixel character is a one-of-a-kind creation, adding a personalized touch to the gaming experience.

Randomized Geo-Coordinates:
The game's landscapes and encounters are powered by API3 QRNG (Quantum Resistant Number Generator). This ensures that the geographical coordinates for pixel battles are truly random and unpredictable, enhancing the excitement and strategic gameplay.

Chainlink Automation:
To keep the gaming environment fresh and engaging, Chainlink automation is integrated to generate new coordinates for pixels every 30 minutes. This dynamic feature ensures that players always have new challenges and opportunities to explore in their surroundings.

WalletConnect SDK:
PixelPals prioritizes user convenience and security by incorporating the WalletConnect SDK. This allows users to seamlessly connect their wallets to the game, ensuring a smooth onboarding experience and enabling them to manage their in-game assets securely.

Pixel Minting:
Upon user signup, a unique pixel is minted and assigned to the user's wallet. This pixel serves as the user's companion throughout their gaming journey and is the key asset for engaging in battles and other in-game activities.

Pixel Marketplace:
PixelPals features a decentralized marketplace where users can list their minted pixels for sale or the pixel they won in battles. The marketplace leverages Chainlink CCIP (Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol), enabling users to buy and sell pixels seamlessly across different blockchain networks.

Multi-Network Integration:
PixelPals operates as the main chain on the Base network , and through the use of Chainlink CCIP, it expands its presence to multiple networks, including Avalanche testnet, Polygon Mumbai, Optimism testnet, and Arbitrum testnet. This multi-network integration ensures cross-chain compatibility, allowing users to interact with the game and marketplace on various blockchain networks

Curvegrid MultiBaaS Integration:
PixelPals enhances its querying capabilities from contracts using Curvegrid Multibaas, providing users with advanced functionality and a seamless experience.
